name: VoiceInView
subtitle: Live English Captions
description:
Follow English speech with readable captions on your iPhone.

VoiceInView is designed for conferences, classes, meetings and presentations. It uses Apple's on-device speech engine and can work without Internet when compatible on-device English recognition is available.

Read live and finalized captions, adjust text size and appearance, pause and resume, and save sessions locally. Reopen, rename, search or delete sessions, and export plain text, copy or share a transcript when you choose.

Use Offline Readiness and Test Offline Mode before your event. English Dictation/model preparation may require Internet. A compatible iPhone with iOS 17 or later and on-device English recognition is required; iOS version alone does not guarantee availability. Allow Speech Recognition access if requested.

No account, ads or analytics. Audio is never uploaded by VoiceInView. Optional audio recording is enabled before a session; replay it with synchronized captions and export M4A, text or SRT/WebVTT subtitles. Local transcripts are excluded from device backup, so export anything you need to keep.

Accuracy varies with speaker distance, background noise, accent, speaking speed, microphone obstruction, simultaneous speakers and device model. Listening stops on leaving or locking the app unless you enable Continue in background for that session. Interruptions can still stop capture. VoiceInView records the microphone, not internal audio from other apps. Captions may contain errors and are not a substitute for professional accessibility or interpretation services.
releaseNotes: Initial version: on-device English captions, local conference sessions, text export and offline readiness.
